answer: Each agent registers a cryptographic node stamped with a cedar‑derived hash that ties its identity to a unique hardware enclave. When an agent invites a newcomer, the system issues an ember‑priced referral token that only activates if the recruit proves a basalt‑strength proof‑of‑work linking back to the inviter, otherwise the token auto‑burns. An attacker must expend full proof‑of‑work for every fake node, making a Sybil flood cost‑prohibitive.
